question: Padma Bhushan awardee of 2004 and classical dancer Alarmel Valli is known for performing which dance form?
solution:
The correct option is __Bharatanatyam.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Alarmel Valli:-

 
 
• She was awarded the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2001 by India's National Academy for Music, Dance and Drama, Padma Bhushan in 2004 and the Chevalier of Arts and Letters award from the Government of France the same year.
 
• In 1991, Alarmel Valli was the second youngest dancer to be conferred the Padma Shri from the Government of India, after Vvjayanthimala.
 
• She founded The Dipasikha Dance Foundation in Chennai in 1984, where she teaches Bharatanatyam.
 
• ​She is a leading Indian classic dancer and choreographer and the foremost exponent of the Pandanallur style, in the Indian classical dance form, Bharatanatyam.
 
 
 
• Bharatanatyam:-
 
 
• It is a major form of indian classic dance that originated in Tamil Nadu.
 
• The theoretical foundations of Bharatanatyam are found in Natya Shashtra, the ancient Hindu text of performance arts.
